In this notebook, I will compile gene expression, differential expression, and gene set scoring outputs into a single Excel file. Differential expression files have been saved - reactome outputs need to be recalculated here.

# Setup


```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(plyr)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(fgsea)

thisseed <- 231103

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

read_excel_allsheets <- function(filename, tibble = TRUE) {
    sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(filename)
    x <- lapply(sheets, function(X) readxl::read_excel(filename, sheet = X))
    if(!tibble) x <- lapply(x, as.data.frame)
    names(x) <- sheets
    x
}

pathways <- gmtPathways("../../data/msigdb/c2.cp.reactome.v2023.2.Hs.symbols.gmt")

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```


# Read Data

```{r}
seuobj <- readRDS("data/objects/annotated/predictCOL__CB_allcells_annotated_251017_v4.rds")
seuobj
```


```{r}
tcrs <- read_csv("data/tcr/filtered_contigs_paired_241120.csv")
tcrs
```

```{r}
seuobj <- AddMetaData(seuobj, tcrs %>% column_to_rownames("barcode") %>% select(cdr3.TRA, cdr3.TRB))
seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(tgroup != "Non-abT")
```

# Gene Expression

## Thelper

```{r}
thelper.ccdvsuc.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>%  droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = c("TOX", "HAVCR2", "TNFRSF4", "TNFRSF18", "LAG3", "CD247", "IFNG", "TNF", "ANXA1", "CXCR3", "GZMK", "IL17A", "IL17F", "IL22", "IL26", "GNLY"),
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "Th17", "Prlf. Teff"),
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, cellstate, denominator.freq, meanVal, featureVar) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy:denominator.freq), names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    group = cellstate,
    group_count = denominator.freq,
  ) %>% 
  arrange(group, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

thelper.ccdvsuc.df
```

## Th17

```{r}
th17.ccdvsuc.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj@meta.data %>% 
                                          filter(!is.na(cdr3.TRA) & !is.na(cdr3.TRB) & timepoint == "T0" & diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC")) %>% 
                                          droplevels, 
                     seurat = "seuobj", 
                     sample.col = "cellstate",
                     features = c("CD4", "CD8A", "IL17A"),
                     filterCol = "cellstate",
                     filterVal = c("Th17"),
                     exportObservationDF = T) %>% 
  select(barcode, featureVal, featureVar) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = featureVar, values_from = featureVal) %>%
  left_join(., 
            seuobj@meta.data %>% rownames_to_column("barcode") %>% select(barcode, cellstate),
            by = "barcode") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    group = cellstate,
  ) %>%
  relocate(group, .after = barcode) %>% 
  arrange(desc(group))
  
th17.ccdvsuc.df
```

```{r}
ccd.pre.tnfaip6.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(atnf = ifelse(antitnf_response == "NOA", "NOA", as.character(antitnf_response))) %>% 
    mutate(atnf = ifelse(antitnf_response %in% c("FR", "PR", "NR"), "aTNF", as.character(antitnf_response))) %>% 
    mutate(atnf = fct_relevel(atnf, c("NOA", "aTNF"))) %>% 
    filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD")) %>% 
    filter(atnf != "NM") %>% 
    filter(timepoint == "T0"),
  seurat = "seuobj",

  relative.to = "celltype",
  filterCol = "celltype",
  filterVal = c("Stroma"),
  xVar = "atnf",

  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
) %>%

  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy:denominator.freq), names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>%
```

## Tfh

### Tfh vs. Tph

```{r}
tfhtph.cellstate.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj@meta.data, 
                     seurat = "seuobj", 
                     sample.col = "cellstate",
                     features = c("ICOS", "CCR7", "MAF", "PDCD1", "IL21", "CXCL13", 
                                  "CXCR5", "BCL6", 
                                  "PRDM1", "CCR5", "CCR2", "CX3CR1"),
                     filterCol = "cellstate",
                     filterVal = c("PD1Lo Tfh", "PD1Hi Tfh", "Prlf. Tfh"),
                     exportObservationDF = T) %>% 
  group_by(cellstate, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(meanVal = mean(featureVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(seVal = sd(featureVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(cellstate, featureVar, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  select(cellstate, denominator.freq, meanVal, featureVar) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    group = cellstate,
    group_count = denominator.freq
  ) %>% 
  arrange(group)
  
tfhtph.cellstate.df
```

```{r}
tfhtph.cells.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(seuobj@meta.data,
```

## UC HLA

```{r}
selectedparticipants.hla <- c("001-036", "001-038")

hla.df <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% filter(diagSub == "UC" & timepoint == "T0") %>% droplevels,
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = c("IL17A", "CXCL13"),
  relative.to = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th17", "PD1Hi Tfh"),
  ncol = 2,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>%
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify = T)[,1]) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, participant_id, NA)) %>% 
  mutate(partCol = fct_relevel(partCol, selectedparticipants.hla)) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = ifelse(participant_id %in% selectedparticipants.hla, "15:01", "Other")) %>% 
  mutate(DRB1 = fct_relevel(DRB1, c("15:01", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(alleleNum = case_when(
    participant_id == "001-036" ~ "2",
    participant_id == "001-038" ~ "1",
    participant_id %notin% c("001-036", "001-038") ~ "0",
  )) %>% 
  select(biopsy, diagSub, DRB1, alleleNum, antitnf_response, timepoint, cellstate, denominator.freq, featureVar, meanVal) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    group = cellstate,
    group_count = denominator.freq,
    `HLA-DRB1` = DRB1,
    Num_1501_Alleles = alleleNum,
  ) %>% 
  relocate(biopsy, diagSub, `HLA-DRB1`, Num_1501_Alleles,
           antitnf_response, timepoint,group, group_count) %>% 
  arrange(group, `HLA-DRB1`, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

hla.df
```

# Combine Lists

```{r}
tnf.out.obs <- obs.dc %>% 
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  select(barcode, celltype, TNF) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(CellType = celltype)
tnf.out.obs
```

```{r}
tnf.out.biopsies <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% 
    filter(diagSub != "UC") %>% 
    filter(timepoint != "R2") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "iCD" & timepoint != "T0")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "UC" & antitnf_response == "NOA")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response == "NM")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response == "NOA")),
  features = "TNF",
  relative.to = "celltype",
  filterCol = "celltype",
  filterVal = c("Myeloid", "TNKILC"),
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "timepoint",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(timepoints = n_distinct(timepoint)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  filter(!(timepoint == "R" & diagSub %notin% c("cCD", "UC"))) %>%
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC"), as.character(timepoint), as.character(diagSub))) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(timegroup == "T0", "PreTx cCD", timegroup)) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(timegroup == "R", "PostTx cCD", timegroup)) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = fct_relevel(timegroup, c("FGID", "iCD", "PreTx cCD", "PostTx cCD"))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "T0", "PreTx", "PostTx")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("PreTx", "PostTx"))) %>% 
  group_by(timegroup, celltype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()

tnf.out.biopsies <- tnf.out.biopsies %>% 
  select(biopsy, celltype, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, timegroup, meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(TNF_Score = meanVal, CellType = celltype) %>% 
  arrange(CellType, timegroup, desc(TNF_Score))

tnf.out.biopsies
```

```{r}
il17.out.colepi <- obs.dc %>% 
  filter(celltype == "ColEpi") %>% 
  select(barcode, il17.sets) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    `IL17 Antimicrobial` = il17af_antimicrobial,
    `IL17 Chemokine` = il17af_chemokines,
    `IL17 Cytokine` = il17af_cytokines,
    `IL17 Remodeling` = il17af_remodeling
  )

il17.out.colepi
```

```{r}
il17.out.biopsies <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% filter(timepoint == "T0") %>%  droplevels,
  features = il17.sets,
  relative.to = "celltype",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(featureVar = fct_recode(featureVar, !!!setNames(names(il17.names), il17.names))) %>% 
  group_by(celltype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()

il17.out.biopsies <- il17.out.biopsies %>% 
  select(biopsy, celltype, diagSub, antitnf_response, timepoint, meanVal, featureVar) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(biopsy:timepoint), names_from = featureVar, values_from = meanVal) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(
    `IL17_Antimicrobial` = Antimicrobial,
    `IL17_Chemokine` = Chemokine,
    `IL17_Cytokine` = Cytokine,
    `IL17_Remodeling` = Remodeling,
    CellType = celltype
  ) %>% 
  arrange(CellType, diagSub, antitnf_response, biopsy)

il17.out.biopsies
```

```{r}
decoupler.out <- list(
  "DC__TNFbyCell" = tnf.out.obs,
  "DC__TNFPrePost" = tnf.out.biopsies,
  "DC__IL17GeneSets" = il17.out.biopsies,
  "DC__IL17ColEpi" = il17.out.colepi
  )
  

decoupler.out
```
